items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Kid René. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, can't take it, that's all.

ctx.x: Well, not a one that I knew, because all those that followed the step of their daddy, like I tell you, they went away. And first thing you know, like I say, through habits, you know, from the habits, they went away. Take like, for instance, Joe Petit's son, Buddy Petit. That guy, he was cut out to be one of our best. A short life.
That's right. A short life. That's right. Kid René. So the first generation makes the success of it and the second couldn't take it.
Yes, can't take it, that's all. And all good people, it's just a pity, you know what I mean? Just a pity.
